answer: Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The nectar decay curve is applied at each close, river records the drop, and dawn recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 20 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
